# telnyx_short_codes (Data Source)

Lists short code settings, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_short_code_settings`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_messaging_profile_id` (String) Filter by Messaging Profile ID. Use the string `null` for phone numbers without assigned profiles. A synonym for the `/messaging_profiles/{id}/short_codes` endpoint when querying about an extant profile.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `short_codes` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--short_codes))

<a id="nestedatt--short_codes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `short_codes`

Read-Only:

- `country_code` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the type of resource.
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) Unique identifier for a messaging profile.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `short_code` (String) Short digit sequence used to address messages.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.
